title: Recording #{id}: side {side}, {kind}
card_wi_title: What-if from the event list, nothing saved
learned_title: Learning model from master comparisons and verdicts: this many of the detections are probably real
audio_deleted_on: Original audio deleted on {date} after the retention period. Measurements, clicks and comparisons are kept; listening and new comparisons are no longer possible.
audio_deleted_no_listen: Original audio deleted – listening is no longer possible
clicks_only_hint: Built from the recording the first time it is played (a few seconds). To keep it: right-click → Save audio.
sensitivity_reset: Sensitivity back to the profile, re-analyzing the recording …
sensitivity_changed: Re-analyzing the recording with the new sensitivity. Open the recording again afterwards.
note_placeholder: e.g. scratch near the edge at track 2
findings_title: Applies to the copy and side of this recording, i.e. to all recordings of it
diff_track_hint: Difference track: only the counted clicks, silence in between. If you hear music in it, it is a false alarm. A different sensitivity re-analyzes the recording.
legend_click: Click in the graph = play from here; zoomed in, the section loops
chart_hint: Drag = zoom, double-click = everything, click = play from here (zoomed in: the section loops). Pops red, clicks yellow, crackle grey; below the axis lead-in and lead-out, not counted.
hover_play: Hovering plays the click under the pointer (in both graphs)
overhang: After the end of the groove at {at}, the recording runs on for {len} with the stylus up: nothing but the chain's own noise.
overhang_confirm: Cut the recording 2 s after the end of the groove at {at}? The last {len} (stylus up, no groove) are deleted from the file, then the recording is analysed again.
overhang_done: Overhang removed ({len}); the recording is being analysed again.
level_hint: Dashed: groove silence (quiet passages, {noise} dBFS). Dotted: music reference ({ref} dBFS). Grey: stylus up
events_hint: The {n} strongest clicks and all skips in one list, by time; click a column to sort.
learned_hint: Column “real?”: probability according to the learning model that the detection is a real click and not music. Estimated real in this recording: {clicks} of {clicks_total} clicks, {ticks} of {ticks_total} crackle, {pops} of {pops_total} pops.
learned_graded: The grade is computed from the estimate.
so_summary: Second opinion (grooveclean network): confirmed {quiet} in pauses, {music} in music
so_unavailable: Second opinion (grooveclean network) not available: PyTorch is not installed on the server.
audit_hint: Audit: ▶ listen and judge. “False alarm” (the music itself, not a click) drops out of count and grade at once and is kept when re-analyzing
show_judged_title: Spots you have already judged as click, false alarm or unclear are hidden; when ticked, they are back in the list
all_judged: All {n} spots of this selection are judged. Load more or tick “show spots already judged”.
col_real_title: Learning model: probability that this is a real click (not music)
col_for_grade_title: What-if: leave a detection out of the grade. The grade is recomputed at once, nothing is saved.
judge_click_tip: Confirmed: a click on the record, counts
judge_music_tip: This is the music itself (attack, snare, plucked string), not a click: drops out of count and grade
judge_unsure_tip: Cannot be decided: stays as detected, i.e. counted
judge_run_out_tip: This is the run-out groove, no damage
judge_no_skip_tip: Rhythm or loop, not a skip
verdict_saved_pops: Verdict “{verdict}” saved · grade now {grade}, pops {pops}/min, clicks in music {music}/min
verdict_saved_quiet: Verdict “{verdict}” saved · grade now {grade}, clicks quiet {quiet}/min, music {music}/min
region_lead_in_title: Before the groove starts: stylus drop or lead-in groove. Never counts.
region_lead_out_title: After the groove ends: run-out groove or stylus lift. Never counts.
region_outside_title: Outside the analyzed groove. Never counts.
region_in_lead_in_title: In the groove, before the first note
region_in_run_out_title: In the groove, after the last note (lead-out up to the end groove)
wi_none_found: None of the marked detections were found.
wi_newer_counts: A newer recording of this side counts for the record grade.
wi_btn_off_title: What-if: compute the grade as if this detection did not exist. Saves nothing.
wi_btn_on_title: What-if: count it again. Saves nothing.
wi_skip_judged_title: Already not a skip by your verdict
